title: ExportView Shown/Hidden is a box-open bit kept in the session beside the export's own stage
trigger: Start an account export, Hide it, switch account and back, reopen Settings > Data & Storage
effect: No bug today (view is closed by the dialog .close hook and read by the DialogSpec predicate); the box's open state is two places (ExportBox::Options in dialogs and export.view in the session) kept in step by hand
fix: fold the visibility into one ExportBox/ExportStage enum owned per account (OnScreen) instead of a Shown/Hidden bit on the session's export

title: AgentPageUi::reset_confirm is a dialog-open bool (stage flag named to dodge the word list), cleared by hand at five sites
trigger: Open Settings > Agent access > Reset token, then turn the master switch off (and on), lock, or close the dialog by Esc
effect: No bug today: agent_reset_open() also checks access::enabled() and close_agent_boxes_for_access_off() clears it; but the box state is a bool reset in agent_dialogs.rs (x3), agent_access.rs and close_agent_boxes_for_access_off, beside the consent Option that is the same kind of box
fix: one AgentBox enum { None, Consent(AllChatsConsent), ResetToken } on AgentUi, replaced whole on close/access-off

title: Detached forever-loop minute timer re-applies appearance (and the OS accent) while the window is hidden, locked or logged out; not in the owned-timers baseline
trigger: Launch Quill, lock it or log out, leave it for an hour
effect: 60 wakes an hour of apply_appearance (and refresh_system_accent with the system-accent option) behind the lock/in the background; cheap (apply_appearance only notifies on a change) but it is the `poll` + `detached` shape the guard exists for, and check-owned-timers.py skips this file because its name says demo, so it was never listed
fix: drive auto-night from a wake: observe the OS appearance/accent change and arm one timer for the next schedule boundary held in the appearance state, or poll in a task owned by the account/screen and parked while locked; rename or exclude only the demo parts of app_demo.rs from the guard

title: A custom theme file that failed to read is cached as `None` and not read again until the themes folder changes
trigger: Pick a custom theme as the day theme; at the next launch its file is unreadable for a moment (locked, mid-write by another tool); the read answers `None`
effect: resolve_app_theme falls back to the built-in default for the whole session and custom_cache keeps `(name, None)`; nothing sends the read again (only refresh_custom_themes, after a change made inside Quill, clears the cache)
fix: cache `Fetch<Palette>`-like stage (Ready/Failed) and treat Failed as a miss the next time the appearance is applied, or do not cache a failed read
